summary: Timed code launches one persistent team; outlined main worker 0x2190 loops to the requested count and calls spmvCpu each pass. spmvCpu's compiled body partitions dim rows by quotient/remainder for thread ID, traverses each row's half-open CSR interval with multiply-add, stores outputs, and barriers before returning. Thus each repetition recomputes all rows/nonzeros.

source_evidence.claim: Full CSR row kernel and timed parallel repetition loop.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock region invokes GOMP_parallel once. Persistent worker 0x2190 compares repetition counter %ebp against requested count %r12d at 0x21dc and loops to 0x21b0. It calls spmvCpu at 0x21d7; callee 0x2090 partitions rows (0x20cc..0x20ee), processes row interval at 0x2110 and every nonzero via 0x2130..0x214c with loads/multiply-add, stores at 0x214e and barriers at 0x216b.
